card.title: 3 min reboot iPhone 16 panic log - 524288

claims.statement: On iPhone 16 / 16 Plus, a 3-minute reboot whose panic-full log carries trigger code 524288 points to the charging port flex.
claims.evidence: Panic log trigger code mapped to the charging port flex on this model.

claims.statement: The air (barometric) sensor must be connected or the reboot continues; if it persists after the port flex swap, replace the air sensor.
claims.evidence: Guide lists air sensor as second suspect after the charge port flex.

claims.statement: A partially seated charging flex or debris/damage in its FPC connector can also trigger the reboot.
claims.evidence: Guide recommends inspecting the FPC connector pins for shorts.

procedure: Confirm it is a timed restart (not a bootloop at the Apple logo).
Open Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics > Analytics Data and open the newest panic-full log.
If the trigger code is 524288, replace the charging port flex with an original pulled part.
Make sure the air sensor is plugged in; replace it if the reboot persists.
Inspect the charge-flex FPC connector for debris, damage or shorts.
card.caveats: Code-to-part mapping is model-specific; verify against the panic log on the device in hand. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
